title: Blow-ups of a graph are graphs of difference quotients
statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ, ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝᵏ → ℝ^{n+k} linear isometries, a ∈ ℝ^{n+k}, f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ any map, v ∈ ℝⁿ and r ≠ 0; put Φ(u) := a + ιu + ι'(f u) and f_{v,r}(w) := r⁻¹(f(v + rw) − f(v)). Then (1) η_{Φ(v),r}(Φ(ℝⁿ)) = {ιw + ι'(f_{v,r}(w)) : w ∈ ℝⁿ}, where η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x) is SimonGMT's blowUpMap; (2) for every w ∈ ℝⁿ the Fréchet derivatives satisfy Df_{v,r}(w) = Df(v + rw) (Mathlib's fderiv, which is 0 at points of non-differentiability).
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (a : Euclid (n + k)) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (v : Euclid n) (r : ℝ), r ≠ 0 → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap (a + ι v + ι' (f v)) r '' Set.range (fun u => a + ι u + ι' (f u)) = Set.range (fun w => ι w + ι' (r⁻¹ • (f (v + r • w) - f v))) ∧ ∀ w : Euclid n, fderiv ℝ (fun w' => r⁻¹ • (f (v + r • w') - f v)) w = fderiv ℝ f (v + r • w)
